page-structure.evidence: Title 'Blue Apron | Meal Kits, Oven-Ready & Ready-to-Eat Meals - No Subscription' is descriptive (2.4.2 passes). Heading outline has no h1 (axe best-practice 'page-has-heading-one' — not a WCAG SC). Main content headings start at h3 ('Meal Kits', 'Dish by Blue Apron', 'Assemble & Bake') with no preceding h1 or h2 — a heading-level skip (1.3.1). Footer headings at h4 ('BLUE APRON', 'Support & Services') continue the orphaned subtree. Cookie banner has its own h2 ('Privacy Preference Center') followed by h3/h4, which are correctly nested within the banner but the banner headings are interspersed with the page outline. hasMain:true, hasNav:true — core landmarks present. No aria-label on the single <nav>, so multiple distinct nav sections share an unlabelled landmark (landmark-unique axe violation).

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: listStyleNone:7 — seven <ul> or <ol> elements have list-style:none without an explicit role='list'. In Safari+VoiceOver this strips list semantics (1.3.1, WebKit-specific). The product listing sections (section[1]/ul, section[2]/ul, section[3]/ul) and footer navigation lists are all candidates. tabWalk order follows DOM order and matches visual top-to-bottom flow — no reading-order mismatch. No modal open state to check background aria-hidden.
